Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs here liked the latency and the cost estimates you showed; they'd like to pilot Redwood on a small set of classification and customer-summarization flows. Before we sign any paperwork, procurement wants a one-page mutual action plan and a clear training schedule for our SI partner (EdgeConsult).

Can you and your partner enablement team send a proposed plan and available training windows for the next 4 weeks? Also marked that Aurora needs SOC2 evidence and a short list of roles who will have access during the pilot.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Subject: Re: Pilot interest + next steps

Devon —

Really excited to move forward. I put together a short mutual action plan and a proposed 3-week enablement cadence attached (Aurora-Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf). High-level asks and commitments:

- Redwood delivers a sandbox deployment with two pinned model variants and a token-based usage cap for the pilot.
- EdgeConsult to lead integration workstreams; Redwood to provide two technical enablement sessions and one joint QA day.
- Aurora provides sample datasets, list of pilot users (<=10), and procurement sign-off within 30 days.

Proposed training windows (all PST):
- Week 1: Tech deep-dive for EdgeConsult (90 mins) — Jan 12 or Jan 14
- Week 2: Integration pair-programming (4 hours over two days) — Jan 19/20
- Week 3: Joint validation + go/no-go review — Jan 28

Kimberly on enablement logistics and Marissa on partner ops are looped. If those dates don't work, tell me preferred days and we'll re-align. I'll also drop a Drive link with the MAP and an editable agenda.

Next step: Devon — confirm SOC2 evidence scope & list of pilot users. Procurement can reply to this thread with any contract timing constraints.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
E: jordan.blake@redwood.ai | M: +1 415-555-0199
